entities.summary: Robert Arthur Seguso is a former professional tennis player from the United States. A doubles specialist, he won four Grand Slam men's doubles titles. He also won the men's doubles gold medal at the 1988 Olympic Games in Seoul, partnering Ken Flach. Seguso reached the world no. 1 doubles ranking in 1985. He won a total of 29 career doubles titles between 1984 and 1991.
